_what: The SIT boxes the proof packs may drive with --remote-ok (an ALLOWLIST: a host not here is refused). Source of truth for the boxes is docs PM/SIT-SERVERS.json (toolset/sit-servers.cjs); the web repo cannot read it, so this is the one copy here. sit-in is the gate box and never goes on it; sit-root and sit-grund take no browser runs.
